source.text: Τὸ λοιπόν, ἀδελφοί μου, χαίρετε ἐν κυρίῳ.

records.literal_gloss: As for the rest, brothers of me, rejoice in Lord.

en.L: Finally, my {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, rejoice in [the] Lord.
en.B: Finally, my {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, rejoice in the Lord.
en.R: And now, my {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, be full of joy in the Lord.

fr.L: Quant au reste, mes {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, réjouissez-vous dans le Seigneur.
fr.B: Pour le reste, mes {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, réjouissez-vous dans le Seigneur.
fr.R: Et maintenant, mes {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, soyez pleins de joie dans le Seigneur.

es.L: Por lo demás, hermanos míos, {{plural_you:alégrense|alegraos}} en [el] Señor.
es.B: Por lo demás, hermanos míos, {{plural_you:alégrense|alegraos}} en el Señor.
es.R: Y ahora, hermanos míos, {{plural_you:estén|estad}} llenos de alegría en el Señor.

sw.L: Kwa yaliyobaki, ndugu zangu, furahini katika Bwana.
sw.B: Hatimaye, ndugu zangu, furahini katika Bwana.
sw.R: Na sasa, ndugu zangu, mjae furaha katika Bwana.

ko.L: 끝으로, 나의 {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 주님 안에서 기뻐하십시오.
ko.B: 끝으로, 나의 {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 주님 안에서 기뻐하십시오.
ko.R: 이제, 나의 {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 주님 안에서 기쁨이 넘치게 하십시오.

vi.L: Sau hết, thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} của tôi, hãy vui mừng trong Chúa.
vi.B: Sau hết, thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} của tôi, hãy vui mừng trong Chúa.
vi.R: Và bây giờ, thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} của tôi, hãy tràn đầy niềm vui trong Chúa.

decisions.choice: as for the rest: a turn to the next matter
alternatives: in conclusion: the letter is about to end
decisions.reason: λοιπόν marks a move on to what remains to be said; it does not promise that the end is near. Paul writes two more chapters and uses the same expression again in 4:8, where the letter really is closing. The sharp change of tone at verse 2 has led some readers to suppose that two letters were joined here, but every manuscript of Philippians has the chapter in this place.

decisions.choice: fellow believers, women and men
decisions.reason: ἀδελφοί addresses the whole church; 4:2 names two women in it.

decisions.choice: a command to rejoice, with the Lord as its ground
alternatives: "farewell in the Lord", the everyday goodbye
decisions.reason: χαίρετε was also how a letter said goodbye, and after "as for the rest" it could sound like one. But Paul has already called for joy in 2:18, and in 4:4 he repeats "rejoice in the Lord" with "always", which only a command can have. As in 4:4, the joy is located in the Lord, not in circumstances.

decisions.choice: {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}
decisions.reason: Paul is addressing the whole church, which includes the women he names in 4:2, so the inclusive default spells that out. Traditional is one tap away.

decisions.choice: be full of joy
decisions.reason: "Rejoice" is now mostly church language; Readable says what it means, as in 4:4.

decisions.choice: And now
decisions.reason: A new reader hears "finally" as "I am about to finish", yet half the letter is still to come. Literal and Balanced keep "Finally", as in 4:8, and the meaning note explains it; Readable uses a plain word for moving on.

decisions.choice: Quant au reste (L); Pour le reste (B)
decisions.reason: The phrase turns to the next matter (m1). French "Enfin" would tell the reader the letter is about to end, though half of it is still to come; "pour le reste" says what the Greek says and needs no explanation. Readable says "Et maintenant", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: hermanos, no setting; ustedes / vosotros forms
decisions.reason: As in Philippians 4:1, Spanish "hermanos" already covers brothers and sisters, so it takes no gender setting. Every plural "you" and its verb is the ustedes / vosotros reader setting, as in the rest of the letter.

decisions.choice: Por lo demás (L, B); Y ahora (R)
decisions.reason: The phrase turns to the next matter, not to the end of the letter (meaning decision m1); "por lo demás" keeps that open, as in 4:8. Readable follows the English "And now".

decisions.choice: Kwa yaliyobaki (L); Hatimaye (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek phrase, "as for the rest", which turns to the next matter rather than closing the letter (m1). Balanced has "Hatimaye" (finally), as the English does; "Mwisho" would sound more like the end of the letter. The same choice is made in 4:8.

decisions.choice: "thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} của tôi" where the Greek has "my brothers"
decisions.reason: Where Paul adds "my" (also 3:17; 4:1), Vietnamese keeps it after the address, which sounds warm in a letter read aloud.

source.text: τὰ αὐτὰ γράφειν ὑμῖν ἐμοὶ μὲν οὐκ ὀκνηρόν, ὑμῖν δὲ ἀσφαλές.

records.literal_gloss: The same things to write to you, to me on the one hand not tiresome, for you on the other hand safe.

en.L: To write the same things to you [is] not tiresome to me, and [it is] safe for you.
en.B: Writing the same things to you again is no burden to me, and for you it is a safeguard.
en.R: I don't mind writing to you about the same things again. It will help keep you safe.

fr.L: Vous écrire les mêmes choses [n’est] pas pénible pour moi, et [c’est] une sécurité pour vous.
fr.B: Vous écrire de nouveau les mêmes choses ne me pèse pas, et pour vous c’est une protection.
fr.R: Cela ne me dérange pas de vous écrire encore sur les mêmes choses. Cela vous aidera à rester en sécurité.

es.L: {{plural_you:Escribirles|Escribiros}} las mismas cosas a mí no [me es] molesto, y para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} [es] seguro.
es.B: Volver a {{plural_you:escribirles|escribiros}} las mismas cosas no es una carga para mí, y para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} es una protección.
es.R: No me molesta {{plural_you:escribirles|escribiros}} otra vez sobre las mismas cosas. Eso {{plural_you:los|os}} ayudará a estar a salvo.

sw.L: Kuwaandikia mambo yale yale hakunichoshi mimi, na kwenu [ni] kinga.
sw.B: Kuwaandikia mambo yale yale tena si mzigo kwangu, nanyi yanawalinda.
sw.R: Sijali kuwaandikia tena kuhusu mambo yale yale. Yatawasaidia kuwa salama.

ko.L: 같은 것을 여러분에게 쓰는 것이 나에게는 번거롭지 않고, 여러분에게는 안전합니다.
ko.B: 같은 것을 여러분에게 다시 쓰는 것이 나에게는 수고가 되지 않고, 여러분에게는 안전장치가 됩니다.
ko.R: 같은 이야기를 다시 써 보내는 것이 나는 귀찮지 않습니다. 그것이 여러분을 안전하게 지켜 줄 것입니다.

vi.L: Viết lại cho anh chị em những điều ấy thì chẳng phiền gì cho tôi, mà lại là điều an toàn cho anh chị em.
vi.B: Viết lại cho anh chị em những điều ấy không phải là gánh nặng cho tôi, mà còn là sự bảo vệ cho anh chị em.
vi.R: Tôi không ngại viết lại cho anh chị em về những điều ấy. Điều đó sẽ giúp giữ cho anh chị em được an toàn.

decisions.choice: things Paul has told them before, here the warning that follows
alternatives: the call to rejoice just given
what he wrote in an earlier letter
decisions.reason: Paul does not say what "the same things" are. They may be the call to joy, which runs through the letter, or warnings he had already given them; verse 18 says he had often told them about the people he describes there. The word "safe" fits a warning best, so the phrase most likely points forward to verse 2. The wording keeps it open.

decisions.choice: no bother to me; a safeguard for you
decisions.reason: ὀκνηρός describes something tiresome or irksome. ἀσφαλής means secure, giving a firm footing: repeating the warning protects them. The two halves are set side by side: for Paul it costs little, for them it gives safety.

decisions.choice: again
decisions.reason: Writing "the same things" means writing them again; Balanced and Readable say so.

source.text: Βλέπετε τοὺς κύνας, βλέπετε τοὺς κακοὺς ἐργάτας, βλέπετε τὴν κατατομήν.

records.literal_gloss: Watch the dogs, watch the bad workers, watch the mutilation.

en.L: Watch out for the dogs, watch out for the evil workers, watch out for the mutilation.
en.B: Be on guard against the dogs, be on guard against the evil workers, be on guard against the mutilators.
en.R: Watch out for those dogs! Watch out for those people who do evil work! Watch out for those who cut the body and call it circumcision!

fr.L: Gardez-vous des chiens, gardez-vous des mauvais ouvriers, gardez-vous de la mutilation.
fr.B: Méfiez-vous des chiens, méfiez-vous des mauvais ouvriers, méfiez-vous des mutilateurs.
fr.R: Faites attention à ces chiens ! Faites attention à ces gens qui font du mal ! Faites attention à ceux qui coupent le corps et qui appellent cela la circoncision !

es.L: {{plural_you:Cuídense|Guardaos}} de los perros, {{plural_you:cuídense|guardaos}} de los malos obreros, {{plural_you:cuídense|guardaos}} de la mutilación.
es.B: {{plural_you:Estén|Estad}} en guardia contra los perros, {{plural_you:estén|estad}} en guardia contra los malos obreros, {{plural_you:estén|estad}} en guardia contra los mutiladores.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Cuídense|Guardaos}} de esos perros! ¡{{plural_you:Cuídense|Guardaos}} de esa gente que hace un trabajo malo! ¡{{plural_you:Cuídense|Guardaos}} de los que cortan el cuerpo y lo llaman circuncisión!

sw.L: Angalieni mbwa, angalieni watenda kazi waovu, angalieni ukatakataji.
sw.B: Muwe macho dhidi ya hao mbwa, muwe macho dhidi ya watenda kazi waovu, muwe macho dhidi ya wakatakataji wa miili.
sw.R: Jihadharini na hao mbwa! Jihadharini na watu hao wanaofanya kazi mbaya! Jihadharini na wale wanaokata mwili na kuuita tohara!

ko.L: 개들을 조심하십시오. 악한 일꾼들을 조심하십시오. 몸을 상하게 하는 일을 조심하십시오.
ko.B: 개들을 경계하십시오. 악한 일꾼들을 경계하십시오. 몸을 잘라 내는 사람들을 경계하십시오.
ko.R: 그 개 같은 사람들을 조심하십시오! 악한 일을 하는 사람들을 조심하십시오! 몸을 베어 놓고 그것을 할례라고 부르는 사람들을 조심하십시오!

vi.L: Hãy coi chừng những con chó, hãy coi chừng những kẻ làm công gian ác, hãy coi chừng sự cắt xẻo.
vi.B: Hãy đề phòng những con chó, hãy đề phòng những kẻ làm công gian ác, hãy đề phòng những kẻ cắt xẻo thân thể.
vi.R: Hãy coi chừng những con chó ấy! Hãy coi chừng những người làm việc ác! Hãy coi chừng những kẻ cắt xẻo thân thể rồi gọi đó là cắt bì!

decisions.choice: dogs: a name of contempt for the unclean
decisions.reason: In the ancient world dogs were mostly scavengers of the street, and Jewish speech used "dogs" as an insult for the unclean, including Gentiles (compare Matthew 15:26 and Revelation 22:15). Paul turns the insult back on people who prided themselves on Jewish marks of belonging.

decisions.choice: workers, as in workers for God, whose work does harm
decisions.reason: ἐργάτης was a word for people at work in God's service (Matthew 9:37-38; 2 Timothy 2:15). In 2 Corinthians 11:13 Paul uses it of "deceitful workers" who rivaled him. These people are busy about religion, but their work is evil.

decisions.choice: mutilation: a pun on circumcision
decisions.reason: κατατομή means a cutting up or mutilating. It rhymes with περιτομή, "circumcision", which Paul uses in the next verse. He refuses to give the name "circumcision" to what these people demand: once Christ has come, cutting the body to earn a place among God's people is mere mutilation, like the gashing of the body that the Law forbade (Leviticus 21:5; 1 Kings 18:28). Compare Galatians 5:12.

decisions.choice: one group, described three ways: people who insisted that believers must be circumcised
decisions.reason: Verse 3 answers all three names at once with "we are the circumcision", so they point to one group whose message was circumcision. Whether they were believers who taught that Gentiles must keep the Law of Moses, as in Acts 15:1 and Galatians, or Jews outside the church, the letter does not say.

decisions.choice: the mutilation (L); the mutilators (B); those who cut the body and call it circumcision (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek pun cannot be copied. Literal keeps the noun, which names the act; Balanced names the people, as the other two warnings do; Readable spells out the point of the pun, which verse 3 makes plain. The meaning note gives the wordplay.

decisions.choice: be on guard against
decisions.reason: βλέπετε, said three times, is a warning to keep an eye on something dangerous. Balanced keeps the threefold repetition.

decisions.choice: la mutilación (L); los mutiladores (B); los que cortan el cuerpo (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek word sounds like the word for circumcision but means cutting up (meaning decision m3). Spanish "mutilación" keeps the harsh sense; Readable spells out the pun, as the English Readable does. "Cuídense" and "guardaos" are the everyday forms of "watch out" in each region.

decisions.choice: ukatakataji (L); wakatakataji wa miili (B); wale wanaokata mwili na kuuita tohara (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek plays on "circumcision" (m3), and "tohara" in verse 3 has no Swahili twin that sounds like it, so Literal and Balanced use "kukatakata" (to cut up, mutilate) and Readable spells out the jibe, as the English Readable does. "Angalieni" in Literal is the plain verb "watch", which here means watch out.

decisions.choice: "몸을 상하게 하는 일" (L); "몸을 잘라 내는 사람들" (B); "몸을 베어 놓고 그것을 할례라고 부르는 사람들" (R)
decisions.reason: The word is a pun on the word for circumcision, a cutting that only mutilates (the meaning decision). Korean cannot make the same pun, so each level says what the word points to, and Readable names circumcision, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "sự cắt xẻo" (L), "những kẻ cắt xẻo thân thể" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word is a pun on circumcision (m3): "cắt xẻo" (to mutilate) shares the verb "cắt" with "cắt bì", so the play is heard, and Readable says it plainly, as the English Readable does. "Kẻ" keeps Paul's sharp tone toward these teachers (m4).

decisions.choice: "những con chó" at every level
decisions.reason: Dogs were a name of contempt for the unclean (m1). Vietnamese keeps the bare picture, which is just as insulting in Vietnamese as in Greek.

source.text: ἡμεῖς γάρ ἐσμεν ἡ περιτομή, οἱ πνεύματι θεοῦ λατρεύοντες καὶ καυχώμενοι ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἐν σαρκὶ πεποιθότες, καίπερ ἐγὼ ἔχων πεποίθησιν καὶ ἐν σαρκί.

records.literal_gloss: We for are the circumcision, the ones by Spirit of God worshiping and boasting in Christ Jesus and not in flesh having confidence, \v 4 although I having confidence also in flesh.

en.L: For we are the circumcision, who worship by [the] Spirit of God and boast in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus and have not put confidence in [the] flesh, \v 4 although I myself have confidence even in [the] flesh.
en.B: For it is we who are the circumcision: we who worship by the Spirit of God, who take pride in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus, and who put no confidence in human credentials, \v 4 even though I myself have grounds for that kind of confidence too.
en.R: It is we who are truly circumcised. We worship by the power of God's Spirit. We boast about {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus, and we do not trust in who we are or what we have done. \v 4 Yet I myself have reasons to trust in those things.

fr.L: Car c’est nous qui sommes la circoncision, nous qui rendons un culte par l’Esprit de Dieu, qui nous glorifions {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus et qui n’avons pas mis notre confiance dans la chair, \v 4 bien que moi, j’aie confiance aussi dans la chair.
fr.B: Car c’est nous qui sommes la circoncision : nous qui rendons un culte par l’Esprit de Dieu, qui mettons notre fierté {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus et qui ne plaçons aucune confiance dans la chair, dans nos titres humains, \v 4 bien que j’aie, moi aussi, des raisons de placer ma confiance dans la chair.
fr.R: C’est nous qui sommes vraiment circoncis. Nous adorons Dieu par la puissance de l’Esprit de Dieu. Nous sommes fiers du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus, et nous ne comptons pas sur ce que nous sommes ou sur ce que nous avons fait. \v 4 Pourtant, moi, j’aurais des raisons de compter sur ces choses.

es.L: Porque nosotros somos la circuncisión, los que adoramos por [el] Espíritu de Dios y nos enorgullecemos en {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} Jesús y no hemos puesto la confianza en [la] carne, \v 4 aunque yo mismo tengo motivos de confianza también en [la] carne.
es.B: Porque somos nosotros la circuncisión: los que adoramos por el Espíritu de Dios, los que nos enorgullecemos en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} Jesús y no ponemos ninguna confianza en los méritos humanos, \v 4 aunque yo mismo tendría motivos para esa clase de confianza.
es.R: Somos nosotros los que de verdad estamos circuncidados. Adoramos a Dios con el poder que da el Espíritu de Dios. Nos sentimos orgullosos {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}} Jesús, y no confiamos en lo que somos ni en lo que hemos hecho. \v 4 Y eso que yo mismo tengo razones para confiar en esas cosas.

sw.L: Kwa maana sisi ndio tohara, tunaoabudu kwa Roho wa Mungu na kujivuna katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu, wala hatuweki tumaini katika mwili, \v 4 ingawa mimi mwenyewe nina tumaini hata katika mwili.
sw.B: Kwa maana ni sisi tulio tohara: sisi tunaoabudu kwa Roho wa Mungu, tunaojivunia {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu, na tusioweka tumaini letu katika sifa za kibinadamu, \v 4 ingawa mimi mwenyewe ninazo sababu za kuwa na tumaini la namna hiyo pia.
sw.R: Ni sisi tuliotahiriwa kweli. Tunaabudu kwa nguvu ya Roho wa Mungu. Tunajivunia {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu, wala hatutegemei sisi ni nani au tumefanya nini. \v 4 Hata hivyo, mimi mwenyewe ninazo sababu za kutegemea mambo hayo.

ko.L: 우리가 바로 할례[받은 사람들]이기 때문입니다. 우리는 하나님의 영으로 예배하고, {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 안에서 자랑하며, 육신을 신뢰하지 않습니다. \v 4 나 자신은 육신에도 신뢰할 만한 것이 있지만 말입니다.
ko.B: 참된 할례를 받은 사람은 바로 우리입니다. 우리는 하나님의 영으로 예배하고, {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수를 자랑하며, 사람의 자격을 신뢰하지 않습니다. \v 4 물론 나 자신은 그런 것을 신뢰할 만한 근거도 가지고 있습니다.
ko.R: 참으로 할례를 받은 사람은 바로 우리입니다. 우리는 하나님의 성령의 능력으로 예배합니다. 우리는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수를 자랑하고, 우리가 어떤 사람인지 또는 무엇을 했는지를 의지하지 않습니다. \v 4 그런데 나 자신은 그런 것들을 의지할 이유가 있습니다.

vi.L: Vì chính chúng ta mới là những người cắt bì, là những người thờ phượng bởi Thánh Linh của Đức Chúa Trời, khoe mình trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} Giê-xu, và không đặt lòng tin cậy nơi xác thịt, \v 4 dù chính tôi cũng có lý do để tin cậy nơi xác thịt.
vi.B: Vì chính chúng ta mới là những người cắt bì thật: chúng ta thờ phượng bởi Thánh Linh của Đức Chúa Trời, tự hào trong Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, và không đặt lòng tin cậy nơi những gì thuộc về con người, \v 4 dù chính tôi cũng có lý do để tin cậy như vậy.
vi.R: Chính chúng ta mới là những người cắt bì thật. Chúng ta thờ phượng nhờ quyền năng của Thánh Linh Đức Chúa Trời. Chúng ta tự hào về Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, và chúng ta không tin cậy vào việc mình là ai hay mình đã làm được gì. \v 4 Dù vậy, chính tôi cũng có những lý do để tin cậy vào những điều ấy.

decisions.choice: the circumcision: God's own covenant people
decisions.reason: "The circumcision" was a name for the Jewish people, marked as God's own by circumcision (Genesis 17:9-14). Paul gives the name to everyone who belongs to Christ, Gentiles included. He says the same in Romans 2:28-29 and Colossians 2:11, and the Law and the Prophets already spoke of a circumcised heart (Deuteronomy 10:16; 30:6; Jeremiah 4:4).

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: who worship by the Spirit of God
decisions.reason: Some manuscripts change the ending of the word for God, so that it reads "who worship God in spirit", and at least one early papyrus has no word for God at all. The SBLGNT follows the reading of the oldest major manuscripts. It is also the harder reading: the verb usually names the one worshiped, so copyists were more likely to supply "God" as its object than to remove it. Either way the worship is the work of the Spirit, not of the flesh.

decisions.choice: boast in, take pride in, rely on with joy
decisions.reason: καυχάομαι means to boast or exult in what one trusts. Believers make Christ their boast rather than themselves, as Jeremiah 9:23-24 says (quoted in 1 Corinthians 1:31).

decisions.choice: the flesh: human status and achievement, what a person is and does apart from God
decisions.reason: Here σάρξ means human standing as people measure it: birth, rite, rank and religious record, the very things listed in verses 5-6. The word fits because circumcision is cut in the flesh, but the point is not the body. It is trusting in oneself rather than in Christ.

decisions.choice: Paul really has these grounds, though he does not rely on them
alternatives: Paul is only supposing for the sake of argument
decisions.reason: The participle states a fact: by human standards Paul has every reason for such confidence, as verses 5-6 will show. He mentions it to show what he has given up, not because he still trusts it.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: human credentials (B); who we are or what we have done (R)
decisions.reason: In everyday English "flesh" means the body or bodily desire, which is not the sense here. Literal keeps "flesh" so the reader can trace the word through verse 4; Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: truly circumcised
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly that Paul is claiming the real meaning of circumcision for believers, which the contrast with verse 2 makes clear.

decisions.choice: la chair, dans nos titres humains (B), where the English Balanced says "human credentials"
decisions.reason: The term sheet keeps "la chair" at Balanced, and French Bibles have long used it for this sense, but a reader could take it as the body or bodily desire. Balanced adds the plain gloss once, as an apposition, so the sense of the meaning decision (m4) is clear and the word can be followed into verse 4. Readable follows the English.

decisions.choice: carne (L); méritos humanos (B); lo que somos o lo que hemos hecho (R)
decisions.reason: Here "flesh" means human status and achievement (meaning decision m4). Literal keeps "carne"; Balanced and Readable say what Paul means, as the English does. "Enorgullecerse" renders the verb for boasting as in 1:26.

decisions.choice: mwili (L) for "the flesh"
decisions.reason: Swahili "mwili" is both body and flesh, and Literal keeps it, as Paul's letters in Swahili do. Balanced and Readable say what it means here (m4): human status and achievement, "sifa za kibinadamu" (B), "sisi ni nani au tumefanya nini" (R).

decisions.choice: "육신" (L); "사람의 자격" (B); "우리가 어떤 사람인지 또는 무엇을 했는지" (R), here and in verse 4
decisions.reason: The flesh here is human status and achievement apart from God (the meaning decision). Literal keeps the letter's word "육신"; Balanced and Readable say what it means, as the English does ("human credentials").

decisions.choice: "할례[받은 사람들]" (L); "참된 할례를 받은 사람" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The circumcision is God's covenant people (the meaning decision). Korean needs a word for people, which Literal brackets; Balanced and Readable add "참된", as the English Readable says "truly circumcised".

decisions.choice: "xác thịt" (L); "những gì thuộc về con người" (B); "việc mình là ai hay mình đã làm được gì" (R) (also 3:4)
decisions.reason: Here flesh is human status and achievement apart from God (m4). Literal keeps "xác thịt", the word kept for sarx; Balanced and Readable say what it means, as the English does, since "xác thịt" alone would be heard as the body or as sinful desire.

decisions.choice: "khoe mình" (L); "tự hào" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Romans (5:2-11): Literal keeps "khoe mình" for this word family, and Balanced and Readable say "tự hào" for the joyful pride in Christ that Paul commends (m3).

source.text: Εἴ τις δοκεῖ ἄλλος πεποιθέναι ἐν σαρκί, ἐγὼ μᾶλλον· περιτομῇ ὀκταήμερος, ἐκ γένους Ἰσραήλ, φυλῆς Βενιαμίν, Ἑβραῖος ἐξ Ἑβραίων, κατὰ νόμον Φαρισαῖος, κατὰ ζῆλος διώκων τὴν ἐκκλησίαν, κατὰ δικαιοσύνην τὴν ἐν νόμῳ γενόμενος ἄμεμπτος.

records.literal_gloss: If anyone thinks other to have confidence in flesh, I more: \v 5 in circumcision eighth-day, of race Israel, of tribe Benjamin, Hebrew of Hebrews, according to law Pharisee, \v 6 according to zeal persecuting the church, according to righteousness the in law having become blameless.

en.L: If anyone else thinks [there is reason] to have confidence in [the] flesh, I [have] more: \v 5 circumcised [on the] eighth day, of [the] people of Israel, of [the] tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; as to [the] law, a Pharisee; \v 6 as to zeal, persecuting the church; as to righteousness that [is] in [the] law, having become blameless.
en.B: If anyone else thinks there are grounds for confidence in human credentials, I have more. \v 5 I was circumcised on the eighth day. I belong to the people of Israel and the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew born of Hebrews. In keeping the law I was a Pharisee; \v 6 in zeal I persecuted the church; in righteousness as the law defines it, I was beyond reproach.
en.R: Some people think they can trust in who they are and what they have done. I have even more reasons to. \v 5 I was circumcised when I was eight days old, as Jewish boys are. I was born into the people of Israel, into the tribe of Benjamin. I am a Hebrew, and so were my parents. When it came to the law, I was a Pharisee, part of a group that kept it very strictly. \v 6 I was so eager to defend God's law that I attacked the church. And when it came to being righteous by keeping the law, no one could find any fault in me.

fr.L: Si quelqu’un d’autre pense [avoir des raisons] d’avoir confiance dans la chair, moi davantage : \v 5 circoncis le huitième jour, du peuple d’Israël, de la tribu de Benjamin, Hébreu né d’Hébreux ; quant à la Loi, Pharisien ; \v 6 quant au zèle, persécutant l’Église ; quant à la justice qui [est] dans la Loi, devenu irréprochable.
fr.B: Si quelqu’un d’autre pense avoir des raisons de se confier dans la chair, j’en ai davantage. \v 5 J’ai été circoncis le huitième jour. J’appartiens au peuple d’Israël, à la tribu de Benjamin ; je suis un Hébreu né d’Hébreux. Pour l’observation de la Loi, j’étais Pharisien ; \v 6 pour le zèle, j’ai persécuté l’Église ; pour la justice que définit la Loi, j’étais irréprochable.
fr.R: Certains pensent pouvoir compter sur ce qu’ils sont et sur ce qu’ils ont fait. Moi, j’ai encore plus de raisons de le faire. \v 5 J’ai été circoncis à l’âge de huit jours, comme les garçons juifs. Je suis né dans le peuple d’Israël, dans la tribu de Benjamin. Je suis un Hébreu, et mes parents l’étaient aussi. Pour ce qui est de la Loi, j’étais Pharisien : je faisais partie d’un groupe qui l’observait de façon très stricte. \v 6 Je voulais tellement défendre la Loi de Dieu que j’ai attaqué l’Église. Et pour ce qui est d’être juste en obéissant à la Loi, personne ne pouvait rien me reprocher.

es.L: Si algún otro cree [tener motivos] para confiar en [la] carne, yo más: \v 5 circuncidado al octavo día, del pueblo de Israel, de [la] tribu de Benjamín, hebreo de hebreos; en cuanto a [la] ley, fariseo; \v 6 en cuanto a celo, perseguidor de la iglesia; en cuanto a la justicia que [está] en [la] ley, hallado irreprochable.
es.B: Si algún otro cree tener motivos para confiar en los méritos humanos, yo tengo más. \v 5 Fui circuncidado al octavo día. Pertenezco al pueblo de Israel y a la tribu de Benjamín; soy hebreo, hijo de hebreos. En cuanto a la ley, fui fariseo; \v 6 en cuanto al celo, perseguí a la iglesia; en cuanto a la justicia tal como la define la ley, fui intachable.
es.R: Hay quienes piensan que pueden confiar en lo que son y en lo que han hecho. Yo tengo todavía más razones para hacerlo. \v 5 Me circuncidaron cuando tenía ocho días, como se hace con los niños judíos. Nací en el pueblo de Israel, en la tribu de Benjamín. Soy hebreo, y también lo eran mis padres. En cuanto a la ley, era fariseo, de un grupo que la cumplía con mucho rigor. \v 6 Tenía tanto celo por defender la ley de Dios que atacaba a la iglesia. Y en cuanto a ser justo por cumplir la ley, nadie podía encontrar ninguna falta en mí.

sw.L: Ikiwa mtu mwingine yeyote anadhani [ana sababu ya] kuweka tumaini katika mwili, mimi zaidi: \v 5 nilitahiriwa siku ya nane, wa taifa la Israeli, wa kabila la Benyamini, Mwebrania wa Waebrania; kuhusu sheria, Farisayo; \v 6 kuhusu bidii, mtesaji wa kanisa; kuhusu haki iliyo katika sheria, nimekuwa bila lawama.
sw.B: Ikiwa mtu mwingine yeyote anadhani ana sababu za kuweka tumaini katika sifa za kibinadamu, mimi nina zaidi. \v 5 Nilitahiriwa siku ya nane. Mimi ni wa taifa la Israeli na wa kabila la Benyamini, Mwebrania mzaliwa wa Waebrania. Katika kuishika sheria nilikuwa Farisayo; \v 6 katika bidii nililitesa kanisa; katika haki kama sheria inavyoieleza, sikuwa na lawama yoyote.
sw.R: Watu wengine wanadhani wanaweza kutegemea wao ni nani na wamefanya nini. Mimi ninazo sababu nyingi zaidi. \v 5 Nilitahiriwa nilipokuwa na umri wa siku nane, kama wavulana wa Kiyahudi wanavyotahiriwa. Nilizaliwa katika taifa la Israeli, katika kabila la Benyamini. Mimi ni Mwebrania, na wazazi wangu pia walikuwa Waebrania. Kuhusu sheria, nilikuwa Farisayo, mmoja wa kundi lililoishika kwa ukali sana. \v 6 Nilikuwa na bidii sana ya kuitetea sheria ya Mungu hata nikalishambulia kanisa. Na kuhusu kuwa mwenye haki kwa kuishika sheria, hakuna mtu aliyeweza kuniona na kosa lolote.

ko.L: 다른 누가 육신을 신뢰할 [이유가 있다고] 생각한다면, 나는 더욱 그렇습니다. \v 5 나는 팔 일째에 할례를 받았고, 이스라엘 민족이요, 베냐민 지파요, 히브리 사람 중의 히브리 사람이요, 율법으로는 바리새파 사람이요, \v 6 열심으로는 교회를 박해하였고, 율법 안에 있는 의로는 흠이 없는 사람이 되었습니다.
ko.B: 다른 누가 사람의 자격을 신뢰할 근거가 있다고 생각한다면, 나에게는 더 많은 근거가 있습니다. \v 5 나는 난 지 팔 일 만에 할례를 받았습니다. 나는 이스라엘 민족이요 베냐민 지파에 속하며, 히브리 사람에게서 난 히브리 사람입니다. 율법을 지키는 일에서는 바리새파 사람이었고, \v 6 열심으로는 교회를 박해했으며, 율법이 정한 의로는 나무랄 데가 없는 사람이었습니다.
ko.R: 어떤 사람들은 자기가 어떤 사람이며 무엇을 했는지를 의지할 수 있다고 생각합니다. 나에게는 그럴 이유가 더 많습니다. \v 5 나는 유대인 남자아이들이 다 그렇듯이 태어난 지 여드레 만에 할례를 받았습니다. 나는 이스라엘 민족, 그 가운데서도 베냐민 지파로 태어났습니다. 나는 히브리 사람이고, 내 부모님도 히브리 사람입니다. 율법에 관해서는, 율법을 아주 엄격하게 지키는 무리인 바리새파 사람이었습니다. \v 6 나는 하나님의 율법을 지키려는 열심이 너무 커서 교회를 공격했습니다. 그리고 율법을 지켜서 의롭게 되는 일에서는 아무도 나에게서 흠을 찾을 수 없었습니다.

vi.L: Nếu có ai khác nghĩ rằng mình [có lý do để] tin cậy nơi xác thịt, thì tôi còn hơn nữa: \v 5 chịu cắt bì vào ngày thứ tám, thuộc dân tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên, thuộc chi phái Bên-gia-min, người Hê-bơ-rơ sinh ra từ người Hê-bơ-rơ; về luật pháp thì là người Pha-ri-si; \v 6 về lòng nhiệt thành thì đã bắt bớ Hội Thánh; về sự công chính trong luật pháp thì không chỗ trách được.
vi.B: Nếu có ai khác nghĩ rằng mình có lý do để tin cậy nơi những gì thuộc về con người, thì tôi còn có nhiều hơn. \v 5 Tôi chịu cắt bì vào ngày thứ tám. Tôi thuộc dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, chi phái Bên-gia-min, là người Hê-bơ-rơ do cha mẹ người Hê-bơ-rơ sinh ra. Về việc giữ luật pháp thì tôi là người Pha-ri-si; \v 6 về lòng nhiệt thành thì tôi đã bắt bớ Hội Thánh; về sự công chính theo luật pháp thì không ai chê trách được tôi.
vi.R: Có những người nghĩ rằng họ có thể tin cậy vào việc mình là ai và mình đã làm được gì. Tôi còn có nhiều lý do hơn thế nữa. \v 5 Tôi chịu cắt bì khi được tám ngày tuổi, như các bé trai Do Thái. Tôi sinh ra trong dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, thuộc chi phái Bên-gia-min. Tôi là người Hê-bơ-rơ, cha mẹ tôi cũng vậy. Về luật pháp, tôi là người Pha-ri-si, thuộc một nhóm giữ luật pháp rất nghiêm ngặt. \v 6 Tôi hăng hái bênh vực luật pháp của Đức Chúa Trời đến nỗi tôi đã tấn công Hội Thánh. Còn về việc trở nên công chính bằng cách giữ luật pháp, thì không ai có thể tìm thấy lỗi gì nơi tôi.

decisions.choice: verses 5-6 complete "I more"; one sentence
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT has a raised dot after "I more". What follows has no verb of its own: it lists the grounds for that claim. So the record keeps verses 4b-6 together.

decisions.choice: circumcised as a Jewish baby, not as an adult convert
decisions.reason: The Law set circumcision on the eighth day after birth (Genesis 17:12; Leviticus 12:3). Paul was born into the covenant; he did not join it later.

decisions.choice: of an honored tribe
decisions.reason: Benjamin gave Israel its first king, Saul, whose name Paul also bore (Acts 13:9, 21), and Paul names his tribe again in Romans 11:1.

decisions.choice: a Hebrew born of Hebrew parents
decisions.reason: The phrase means a Hebrew descended from Hebrews. It may also mean that his family kept the language and ways of their people while living abroad in Tarsus: Acts 6:1 distinguishes "Hebrews" from Greek-speaking Jews, and Acts 21:40 has Paul speaking to the crowd in the Hebrew language.

decisions.choice: a Pharisee in his approach to the law
decisions.reason: The Pharisees were a movement known for exact keeping of the law and its traditions; Paul calls them "the strictest party of our religion" in Acts 26:5.

decisions.choice: zeal for God and his law, which drove him to persecute
decisions.reason: Paul uses "zeal" of his devotion to God and the traditions of his fathers, which led him to hunt down believers (Acts 22:3-4; Galatians 1:13-14). The verb is the same one he uses for his pursuit of Christ in verses 12 and 14.

decisions.choice: measured by the law's standard, his record was beyond reproach
decisions.reason: Paul is not claiming to have been without sin. He means that by the standard the law sets, as people could see and judge it, no charge could be brought against him; the law itself provided sacrifices for failures. Verse 9 sets this "righteousness of my own" against the righteousness that comes from God.

decisions.choice: as Jewish boys are; part of a group that kept it very strictly; eager to defend God's law
decisions.reason: Readable explains facts the first readers knew: why the eighth day matters, who the Pharisees were, and what Paul's zeal was for. Each follows the meaning notes; the last draws on Acts 22:3 and Galatians 1:14.

decisions.choice: beyond reproach (B); no one could find any fault in me (R)
decisions.reason: ἄμεμπτος means that no one could lay blame; the English keeps the sense of a record others could inspect, not a claim to be sinless.

decisions.choice: la Loi, capitalised; Pharisien, capitalised; l’Église (for the whole book)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet has it: the law here is the Law of Moses, so it takes the capital, and the Pharisees are named with a capital as in the Gospels. The church Paul persecuted is the people of God as a whole, so "l’Église".

decisions.choice: hallado irreprochable (L); intachable (B)
decisions.reason: The participle means he had come to be blameless by the law's measure (meaning decision m7). Literal keeps a participle, as the Greek list does; Balanced uses the plain adjective.

decisions.choice: "바리새파 사람", "베냐민 지파", "히브리 사람"
decisions.reason: The style guide gives "바리새파 사람들" for the Pharisees, the current word; the other names keep their established Protestant forms.

decisions.choice: "율법 안에 있는 의" (L); "율법이 정한 의" (B); "율법을 지켜서 의롭게 되는 일" (R)
decisions.reason: "의" stays the key term at every level; here it is righteousness measured by the law's standard (the meaning decision), set against the righteousness from God in verse 9.

decisions.choice: "Bên-gia-min", "người Hê-bơ-rơ", "người Pha-ri-si"
decisions.reason: The Protestant forms of the names, as the style guide sets. "Hê-bơ-rơ" keeps Paul's own word for a Jew of Hebrew-speaking family (m4), set apart from "người Do Thái".

source.text: Ἀλλὰ ἅτινα ἦν μοι κέρδη, ταῦτα ἥγημαι διὰ τὸν Χριστὸν ζημίαν.

records.literal_gloss: But whatever things were to me gains, these I have considered because of the Christ loss.

en.L: But whatever [things] were gains to me, these I have counted [as] loss because of the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}.
en.B: But whatever was profit to me, I have come to count as loss because of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.
en.R: But all those things I once thought were in my favor, I now see as a loss, because of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.

fr.L: Mais tout ce qui était pour moi des gains, cela, je l’ai tenu pour une perte à cause du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.
fr.B: Mais tout ce qui était pour moi un profit, j’en suis venu à le considérer comme une perte à cause du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.
fr.R: Mais toutes ces choses que je croyais autrefois à mon avantage, je les vois maintenant comme une perte, à cause du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.

es.L: Pero las cosas que eran para mí ganancias, estas las he considerado pérdida por causa del {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}.
es.B: Pero todo lo que para mí era ganancia, lo he llegado a considerar pérdida por causa {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}.
es.R: Pero todo lo que antes creía que estaba a mi favor, ahora lo veo como una pérdida, por causa {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}.

sw.L: Lakini yote yaliyokuwa faida kwangu, hayo nimeyahesabu hasara kwa sababu ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.B: Lakini chochote kilichokuwa faida kwangu, nimekuja kukiona kuwa hasara kwa sababu ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.R: Lakini mambo yote ambayo zamani niliona yananifaa, sasa ninayaona kuwa hasara, kwa sababu ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.

ko.L: 그러나 나에게 이익이던 것들을, 나는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 때문에 손실로 여기게 되었습니다.
ko.B: 그러나 나에게 유익하던 것은 무엇이든지, 나는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 때문에 손해로 여기게 되었습니다.
ko.R: 그러나 전에는 나에게 유리하다고 생각했던 그 모든 것을, 이제 나는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 때문에 손해로 여깁니다.

vi.L: Nhưng những điều trước kia là lợi cho tôi, thì vì {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, tôi đã coi là lỗ.
vi.B: Nhưng những gì trước kia là lợi cho tôi, thì vì {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, tôi đã coi là lỗ.
vi.R: Nhưng tất cả những điều trước kia tôi cho là có lợi cho mình, bây giờ tôi xem là lỗ, vì {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}.

decisions.choice: gains and loss: the language of a business ledger
decisions.reason: κέρδος and ζημία are trading words: profit and loss. The plural "gains" (each advantage listed in verses 5-6) becomes a single "loss": taken together they have moved to the other column. The ledger image runs on through verse 8.

decisions.choice: a settled judgment, made once and still held
decisions.reason: ἥγημαι is a perfect: Paul reached this verdict in the past and it still stands. In verse 8 he switches to the present to say he holds it today.

decisions.choice: because of Christ: Christ is the reason for the new valuation
decisions.reason: διὰ with the accusative gives the reason. Knowing Christ changed the worth of everything else; verse 8 explains how.

decisions.choice: the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting. The Greek has the article; Literal keeps it.

decisions.choice: profit (B); in my favor (R)
decisions.reason: "Profit" keeps the ledger image in natural English; Readable says what a gain on the account means.

decisions.choice: ganancia, pérdida
decisions.reason: The words of a ledger, gains and losses (meaning decision m1); Spanish "ganancia" and "pérdida" are the same pair and are carried on through verse 8.

decisions.choice: "이익 ... 손실" (L); "유익 ... 손해" (B, R), here and in verse 8
decisions.reason: The words are a business ledger's (the meaning decision): gain and loss. Korean keeps the pair as accounting words at every level, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "lợi ... lỗ" at every level, and "lỗ", "chịu mất" in verse 8
decisions.reason: Gain and loss are the language of a business ledger (m1). Vietnamese "lời" or "lợi" and "lỗ" are the words of a trader's accounts, so the picture is kept.

source.text: ἀλλὰ μενοῦνγε καὶ ἡγοῦμαι πάντα ζημίαν εἶναι διὰ τὸ ὑπερέχον τῆς γνώσεως Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ κυρίου μου δι’ ὃν τὰ πάντα ἐζημιώθην, καὶ ἡγοῦμαι σκύβαλα ἵνα Χριστὸν κερδήσω καὶ εὑρεθῶ ἐν αὐτῷ, μὴ ἔχων ἐμὴν δικαιοσύνην τὴν ἐκ νόμου ἀλλὰ τὴν διὰ πίστεως Χριστοῦ, τὴν ἐκ θεοῦ δικαιοσύνην ἐπὶ τῇ πίστει, τοῦ γνῶναι αὐτὸν καὶ τὴν δύναμιν τῆς ἀναστάσεως αὐτοῦ καὶ κοινωνίαν παθημάτων αὐτοῦ, συμμορφιζόμενος τῷ θανάτῳ αὐτοῦ, εἴ πως καταντήσω εἰς τὴν ἐξανάστασιν τὴν ἐκ νεκρῶν.

records.literal_gloss: But more than that indeed also I consider all things loss to be because of the surpassing of the knowledge of Christ Jesus the Lord of me, because of whom the all things I suffered loss, and I consider them dung, so that Christ I may gain \v 9 and be found in him, not having my righteousness the from law but the through faith of Christ, the from God righteousness upon the faith, \v 10 the to know him and the power of the resurrection of him and sharing of sufferings of him, being conformed to the death of him, \v 11 if somehow I may arrive at the out-resurrection the from dead.

en.L: But more than that, I even count all things to be loss because of the surpassing [greatness] of the knowledge of {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus my Lord, because of whom I suffered the loss of all things, and I count [them] dung, so that I may gain {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} \v 9 and be found in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, not having my own righteousness that [is] from [the] law, but that which [is] through faith in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, the righteousness from God [resting] on faith, \v 10 to know {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and the power of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} resurrection and [the] sharing of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sufferings, being conformed to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} death, \v 11 if somehow I may arrive at the resurrection from [the] dead.
en.B: More than that, I count everything as loss because knowing {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus my Lord is worth far more than all of it. For {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sake I have lost everything, and I count it all as dung, so that I may gain {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} \v 9 and be found in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, with no righteousness of my own from keeping the law, but with the righteousness that comes through faith in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}: righteousness from God, resting on faith. \v 10 I want to know {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, to know the power of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} resurrection and what it is to share in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sufferings, as I am being shaped into the likeness of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} death, \v 11 hoping that somehow I may arrive at the resurrection from the dead.
en.R: More than that, I count everything as a loss, because knowing {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus my Lord is worth so much more. Because of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} I have lost everything, and I think of it all as no better than dung. What I want is to gain {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} \v 9 and to be found joined to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. I do not want a righteousness of my own that comes from keeping the law. I want the righteousness that comes through faith in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. That righteousness comes from God, and it is received by faith. \v 10 I want to know {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and the power of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} rising from death. I want to share in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sufferings and become like {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} death. \v 11 Then I hope that, somehow, I too will rise from the dead.

fr.L: Bien plus, je considère même que tout est perte à cause de la valeur supérieure de la connaissance du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus mon Seigneur, pour qui j’ai subi la perte de toutes choses, et je [les] considère comme du fumier, afin de gagner le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} \v 9 et d’être trouvé en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, n’ayant pas ma propre justice, celle qui [vient] de la Loi, mais celle qui [vient] par la foi au {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, la justice qui [vient] de Dieu, [fondée] sur la foi, \v 10 pour {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} connaître, ainsi que la puissance de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} résurrection et la participation à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} souffrances, étant rendu conforme à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} mort, \v 11 si de quelque manière je parviens à la résurrection d’entre les morts.
fr.B: Bien plus, je considère tout comme une perte, parce que connaître le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus mon Seigneur vaut bien plus que tout cela. À cause de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, j’ai tout perdu, et je tiens tout cela pour du fumier, afin de gagner le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} \v 9 et d’être trouvé en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, non pas avec une justice à moi, venant de l’observation de la Loi, mais avec la justice qui vient par la foi au {{christos:Christ|Messie}} : la justice qui vient de Dieu et qui repose sur la foi. \v 10 Je veux {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} connaître, connaître la puissance de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} résurrection et ce que c’est que d’avoir part à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} souffrances, tandis que je suis façonné à la ressemblance de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} mort, \v 11 dans l’espoir de parvenir, d’une manière ou d’une autre, à la résurrection d’entre les morts.
fr.R: Bien plus, je considère tout comme une perte, parce que connaître le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus mon Seigneur vaut tellement plus. À cause de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, j’ai tout perdu, et pour moi, tout cela ne vaut pas mieux que du fumier. Ce que je veux, c’est gagner le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} \v 9 et être trouvé uni à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Je ne veux pas d’une justice à moi, qui viendrait de l’obéissance à la Loi. Je veux la justice qui vient par la foi au {{christos:Christ|Messie}}. Cette justice vient de Dieu, et on la reçoit par la foi. \v 10 Je veux {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} connaître, et connaître la puissance qui a agi quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est relevé d’entre les morts. Je veux avoir part à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} souffrances et devenir comme {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} mort. \v 11 Alors j’espère que, d’une manière ou d’une autre, je ressusciterai moi aussi d’entre les morts.

es.L: Pero aún más, considero que todo es pérdida por la incomparable [grandeza] del conocimiento de {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} Jesús, mi Señor, por causa de quien lo he perdido todo, y lo considero estiércol, para ganar {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}} \v 9 y ser hallado en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, no teniendo mi propia justicia, la que [viene] de [la] ley, sino la que [es] por medio de la fe en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}, la justicia que [viene] de Dios [basada] en la fe, \v 10 a fin de conocerlo y el poder de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} resurrección y [la] participación en {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} sufrimientos, siendo hecho semejante a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} muerte, \v 11 por si de algún modo llego a la resurrección de entre [los] muertos.
es.B: Más aún, considero todo como pérdida, porque conocer {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}} Jesús, mi Señor, vale muchísimo más que todo eso. Por {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo he perdido todo, y lo considero estiércol, para ganar {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}} \v 9 y ser hallado en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, sin una justicia propia que venga de cumplir la ley, sino con la justicia que viene por medio de la fe en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}: la justicia que viene de Dios y se basa en la fe. \v 10 Quiero conocerlo a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, conocer el poder de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} resurrección y lo que es participar en {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} sufrimientos, mientras soy formado a semejanza de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} muerte, \v 11 con la esperanza de llegar de algún modo a la resurrección de entre los muertos.
es.R: Más aún, considero todo como una pérdida, porque conocer {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}} Jesús, mi Señor, vale mucho más. Por {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo he perdido todo, y lo considero nada mejor que estiércol. Lo que quiero es ganar {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}} \v 9 y estar unido a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. No quiero una justicia propia que venga de cumplir la ley. Quiero la justicia que viene por medio de la fe en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}. Esa justicia viene de Dios, y se recibe por la fe. \v 10 Quiero conocerlo a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} y el poder de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} resurrección. Quiero participar en {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} sufrimientos y llegar a ser como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} muerte. \v 11 Así espero que, de algún modo, yo también resucite de entre los muertos.

sw.L: Zaidi ya hayo, kwa kweli nayahesabu pia mambo yote kuwa hasara kwa sababu ya ubora unaopita wote wa kumjua {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu Bwana wangu, ambaye kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} nimepata hasara ya mambo yote, nami nayahesabu kuwa mavi, ili nimpate {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} \v 9 na nionekane kuwa ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, nisiwe na haki yangu mwenyewe itokayo katika sheria, bali ile iliyo kupitia imani katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, haki itokayo kwa Mungu [inayotegemea] imani, \v 10 ili kumjua {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} na nguvu ya ufufuo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} na ushirika wa mateso {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, nikifananishwa na kifo {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}}, \v 11 ikiwa kwa namna yoyote nipate kufikia ufufuo kutoka kwa wafu.
sw.B: Zaidi ya hayo, nayahesabu mambo yote kuwa hasara, kwa sababu kumjua {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu Bwana wangu kuna thamani kubwa kuliko yote hayo. Kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} nimepoteza kila kitu, nami nakihesabu chote kuwa mavi, ili nimpate {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} \v 9 na nionekane kuwa ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, bila haki yangu mwenyewe inayotokana na kuishika sheria, bali nikiwa na haki inayopatikana kupitia imani katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}: haki itokayo kwa Mungu, inayotegemea imani. \v 10 Nataka kumjua {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}, kujua nguvu ya ufufuo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, na maana ya kushiriki mateso {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, ninapofanywa kufanana {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} katika kifo {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}}, \v 11 nikitumaini kwamba kwa namna fulani nitafikia ufufuo kutoka kwa wafu.
sw.R: Zaidi ya hayo, nakihesabu kila kitu kuwa hasara, kwa sababu kumjua {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu Bwana wangu kuna thamani kubwa zaidi sana. Kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} nimepoteza kila kitu, nami ninakiona chote kuwa si bora kuliko mavi. Ninachotaka ni kumpata {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} \v 9 na kuonekana nikiwa nimeunganishwa {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}. Sitaki haki yangu mwenyewe inayotokana na kuishika sheria. Nataka haki inayopatikana kupitia imani katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. Haki hiyo inatoka kwa Mungu, nayo hupokewa kwa imani. \v 10 Nataka kumjua {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}, na kuijua nguvu iliyomfufua kutoka kwa wafu. Nataka kushiriki mateso {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} na kufanana {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} katika kifo {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}}. \v 11 Hapo natumaini kwamba, kwa namna fulani, mimi pia nitafufuka kutoka kwa wafu.

ko.L: 그뿐만 아니라, 나는 나의 주 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수를 아는 지식의 탁월함 때문에 모든 것을 손실로 여깁니다. 나는 그분 때문에 모든 것을 잃었고, 그것들을 배설물로 여깁니다. 이는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 얻고 \v 9 그분 안에서 발견되려는 것입니다. 나는 율법에서 [난] 나의 의가 아니라, {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 믿는 믿음을 통한 [의], 곧 믿음에 근거한 하나님께로부터 [온] 의를 가지고, \v 10 그분과 그분의 부활의 능력과 그분의 고난에 참여함을 알고, 그분의 죽음을 본받아, \v 11 어떻게 해서든지 죽은 사람들 가운데서 부활에 이르려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 그뿐만 아니라, 나의 주 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수를 아는 것이 그 모든 것보다 훨씬 더 귀하기 때문에, 나는 모든 것을 손해로 여깁니다. 그분 때문에 나는 모든 것을 잃었고, 그것을 다 배설물로 여깁니다. 그것은 내가 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 얻고 \v 9 그분 안에서 발견되려는 것입니다. 나는 율법을 지켜서 얻는 나 자신의 의가 아니라, {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 믿는 믿음으로 얻는 의, 곧 믿음에 근거하여 하나님께로부터 오는 의를 가지려고 합니다. \v 10 나는 그분을 알고, 그분의 부활의 능력을 알고, 그분의 고난에 함께 참여하는 것이 무엇인지 알기를 원합니다. 그렇게 나는 그분의 죽음을 본받아 그 모습을 닮아 가며, \v 11 어떻게 해서든지 죽은 사람들 가운데서 부활에 이르기를 바랍니다.
ko.R: 그뿐만 아니라, 나는 모든 것을 손해로 여깁니다. 나의 주 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수를 아는 것이 그보다 훨씬 더 귀하기 때문입니다. 그분 때문에 나는 모든 것을 잃었습니다. 그리고 그 모든 것을 더러운 배설물보다 나을 것이 없다고 여깁니다. 내가 원하는 것은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 얻고, \v 9 그분과 하나가 된 사람으로 발견되는 것입니다. 나는 율법을 지켜서 얻는 나 자신의 의를 원하지 않습니다. 나는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 믿는 믿음으로 얻는 의를 원합니다. 그 의는 하나님께로부터 오고, 믿음으로 받습니다. \v 10 나는 그분을 알고, 그분이 죽음에서 살아나신 능력을 알기를 원합니다. 나는 그분의 고난에 함께하고, 그분이 죽으신 것처럼 그분을 닮기를 원합니다. \v 11 그러면 어떻게 해서든지 나도 죽은 사람들 가운데서 살아나게 되기를 바랍니다.

vi.L: Hơn thế nữa, tôi còn coi mọi sự là lỗ vì sự hiểu biết {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} Giê-xu, Chúa tôi, là điều quý hơn hết, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà tôi đã chịu mất mọi sự, và tôi coi những điều ấy như phân rác, để tôi được {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} \v 9 và được thấy ở trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, không có sự công chính của riêng tôi đến từ luật pháp, nhưng có sự công chính đến qua đức tin nơi {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, là sự công chính đến từ Đức Chúa Trời dựa trên đức tin, \v 10 để biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và quyền năng của sự sống lại của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và sự dự phần vào những sự đau khổ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, được làm cho giống với sự chết của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \v 11 mong sao tôi đạt đến sự sống lại từ trong kẻ chết.
vi.B: Hơn thế nữa, tôi coi mọi sự là lỗ, vì được biết Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, Chúa tôi, là điều quý giá hơn tất cả những điều ấy. Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, tôi đã mất tất cả, và tôi coi tất cả như phân rác, để được {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} \v 9 và được thấy ở trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, không có sự công chính của riêng mình nhờ giữ luật pháp, nhưng có sự công chính đến qua đức tin nơi {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}: sự công chính đến từ Đức Chúa Trời, dựa trên đức tin. \v 10 Tôi muốn biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, biết quyền năng của sự sống lại của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và biết thế nào là dự phần vào những sự đau khổ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, trong khi tôi đang được uốn nắn cho giống với sự chết của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \v 11 với hy vọng rằng bằng cách nào đó tôi sẽ đạt đến sự sống lại từ trong kẻ chết.
vi.R: Hơn thế nữa, tôi xem mọi thứ là lỗ, vì được biết Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, Chúa tôi, quý giá hơn rất nhiều. Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, tôi đã mất tất cả, và tôi xem tất cả những thứ ấy chẳng hơn gì phân rác. Điều tôi muốn là được {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} \v 9 và được thấy là thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Tôi không muốn có một sự công chính của riêng mình đến từ việc giữ luật pháp. Tôi muốn có sự công chính đến qua đức tin nơi {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}. Sự công chính ấy đến từ Đức Chúa Trời, và được nhận lãnh bởi đức tin. \v 10 Tôi muốn biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và quyền năng đã khiến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sống lại từ cõi chết. Tôi muốn dự phần vào những sự đau khổ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và trở nên giống {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong sự chết của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \v 11 Khi đó tôi hy vọng rằng, bằng cách nào đó, tôi cũng sẽ sống lại từ cõi chết.

decisions.choice: more than that: Paul goes further than verse 7
decisions.reason: The run of particles strengthens what he has just said. Verse 7 spoke of his former advantages; now he counts "all things" loss, and the present tense says he still does.

decisions.choice: the surpassing worth of knowing Christ personally
decisions.reason: γνῶσις here is knowing a person, as the Scriptures speak of knowing God (Jeremiah 31:34; Hosea 6:3), not information about him; verse 10 makes the aim "to know him". ὑπερέχω is the same verb as in 4:7, where God's peace surpasses all understanding.

decisions.choice: Paul actually lost these things, not only counted them lost
decisions.reason: ἐζημιώθην is a passive past-tense verb: he suffered the loss. Becoming a follower of Jesus cost him the standing he had described in verses 5-6.

decisions.choice: filth fit only to be thrown out; a deliberately coarse word
alternatives: rubbish, garbage: worthless but not crude
decisions.reason: σκύβαλον was used both of refuse, such as scraps thrown to the dogs, and of excrement. Either way it is the strongest word Paul could find for something worthless and repellent, and it has a coarse edge. Which of the two senses is uppermost cannot be settled; both say the same thing about the value of his old advantages.

decisions.choice: gain Christ and be found in him: belong to Christ now and when God examines his life
decisions.reason: The ledger image goes on: what now stands in the profit column is Christ himself. "Be found" looks at how God will find him; being "in him" is Paul's way of speaking of union with Christ, which is already true and will be shown at the end.

decisions.choice: righteousness as a right standing before God
decisions.reason: Here righteousness is a standing before God, not simply good conduct. Paul contrasts a righteousness "of my own", the law-measured record of verse 6, with one that comes "from God". Romans 10:3 makes the same contrast.

decisions.choice: through faith in Christ
decisions.reason: With a person's name after it, πίστις can mean faith that person has or faith directed to that person. Read the first way, Paul means Christ's own faithfulness to God, shown in his obedience to death (2:8), and "on faith" at the end of the verse is the believer's answer. Read the second way, he means the believer's faith in Christ. For "faith in Christ": the end of the verse most naturally speaks of the believer's faith, and in Galatians 2:16 the same kind of phrase sits beside "we too have believed in Christ Jesus". For "faithfulness of Christ": the verse would otherwise say the same thing twice, and Paul writes of "the faith of Abraham" for Abraham's own faith (Romans 4:16) and of "the faithfulness of God" (Romans 3:3). Both readings agree that this righteousness comes from God and not from the law. We follow the first and give the second in a footnote.

decisions.choice: resting on faith: faith is how it is received
decisions.reason: ἐπὶ gives the basis: this righteousness is God's gift and faith is the ground on which it is received, not a new achievement that earns it.

decisions.choice: to know him: the aim of everything before
decisions.reason: The article with the infinitive gives the purpose of all that precedes: gaining Christ and being found in him lead to knowing him. To know Christ is to know him in experience: his risen power and his sufferings.

decisions.choice: the power shown in Christ's resurrection, now at work in believers
alternatives: only the future resurrection of believers
decisions.reason: Paul wants to know now the power that raised Jesus, the same power God puts to work in those who believe (Romans 8:11; Ephesians 1:19-20). He speaks of his own future resurrection separately, in verse 11.

decisions.choice: a sharing, a partnership in his sufferings
decisions.reason: κοινωνία is a key word in this letter: partnership in the gospel (1:5) and sharing in the Spirit (2:1). Here Paul shares in what Christ suffered, as he does in his imprisonment (1:29-30).

decisions.choice: being shaped to match his death: an echo of 2:6-8
decisions.reason: συμμορφίζομαι is built on the word for "form" used in 2:6-7, where Christ, being in the form of God, took the form of a servant and was obedient to death. The present tense says it is happening now. Verse 21 completes the pattern: the one being shaped to his death will be given a body shaped like his glory.

decisions.choice: humble hope, not doubt that God will raise him
alternatives: real uncertainty about his own salvation
decisions.reason: εἴ πως, "if somehow", expresses hope and humility about the way ahead, perhaps through death or martyrdom, rather than doubt about the outcome; elsewhere in the letter Paul is sure that dying means being with Christ (1:21-23) and that Christ will transform his body (3:21). Verses 12-14 show the same humility: he has not yet arrived.

decisions.choice: the resurrection out from among the dead
decisions.reason: ἐξανάστασις occurs only here in the New Testament. Its extra prefix, with "from the dead", points to rising out from among those who have died: the resurrection of those who belong to Christ.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}}
decisions.reason: Pronouns for Christ follow the reader's setting.

decisions.choice: dung (L, B); no better than dung (R)
decisions.reason: The word is harsher than "rubbish" or "garbage", which make Paul sound merely tidy. "Dung" keeps both the worthlessness and the coarse edge without being vulgar to a modern ear. A footnote gives the milder "rubbish".

decisions.choice: three English sentences; "I want to know him"; "hoping"
decisions.reason: Balanced breaks Paul's long sentence after "faith" and starts again with "I want to know him", which states the purpose the infinitive gives. "Hoping" carries the "if somehow" of verse 11 (meaning note m13).

decisions.choice: joined to him; from keeping the law; received by faith; I hope
decisions.reason: Readable says what each short phrase means: being "in" Christ is being joined to him (as in 4:7), righteousness "from the law" is the kind earned by keeping it, "on faith" means faith is how it is received, and "if somehow" expresses hope.

decisions.choice: du fumier (L, B); ne vaut pas mieux que du fumier (R)
decisions.reason: As in English: the word is deliberately coarse (m4). "Des ordures" or "de la boue" would make Paul sound merely tidy; "du fumier" keeps both the worthlessness and the rough edge without being vulgar.

decisions.choice: estiércol (L, B); nada mejor que estiércol (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek word is deliberately coarse (meaning decision m4). "Basura" would soften it; "estiércol" keeps the force without being vulgar, as the English "dung" does.

decisions.choice: mavi (dung)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision (m4) says Paul chose a deliberately coarse word. "Takataka" (rubbish) would soften it; "mavi" keeps the force, as the English "dung" does, and Readable says "si bora kuliko mavi" (no better than dung).

decisions.choice: "배설물" (L, B); "더러운 배설물보다 나을 것이 없다" (R)
decisions.reason: The word is deliberately coarse (the meaning decision): filth fit only to be thrown out. "배설물" (excrement) keeps the coarseness while staying fit to be read aloud in church; "쓰레기" (rubbish) would soften it, as the English avoids "rubbish".

decisions.choice: "{{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 믿는 믿음" at every level, as in Galatians 2:16
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads it as faith in Christ, with his own faithfulness as the other reading; Korean "...의 믿음" would be read as his own faith. "의" stays the key term, here a right standing before God (the meaning decision).

decisions.choice: Literal breaks the one Greek sentence of verses 8-11 into sentences, with "이는 ... 하려는 것입니다" to show that verses 9-11 give the purpose
decisions.reason: Korean cannot carry one verb-final sentence across four verse markers and keep each verse's content after its marker.

decisions.choice: "phân rác" at every level
decisions.reason: The word is filth fit only to be thrown out, deliberately coarse (m4). "Rác rưởi" is only rubbish; "phân rác" keeps the coarse edge, as the English keeps "dung".

decisions.choice: "sự công chính ... đến qua đức tin nơi {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} ... dựa trên đức tin"
decisions.reason: The key terms of the letter at every level, and "đức tin nơi" for faith in Christ (m7), as in Galatians 2:16 and the Vietnamese Romans (3:22).

source.text: Οὐχ ὅτι ἤδη ἔλαβον ἢ ἤδη τετελείωμαι, διώκω δὲ εἰ καὶ καταλάβω, ἐφ’ ᾧ καὶ κατελήμφθην ὑπὸ Χριστοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: Not that already I received or already have been perfected, I pursue but if also I may lay hold, on which also I was laid hold of by Christ.

en.L: Not that I have already received [it] or have already been made perfect, but I pursue [it], if indeed I may lay hold [of it], because I also was laid hold of by {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}.
en.B: I do not mean that I already have all this, or that I have already been made perfect. But I keep pursuing it, trying to take hold of it, because {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} has taken hold of me.
en.R: I am not saying that I already have all this, or that I am already perfect. But I keep running after it, trying to catch hold of it, because {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} caught hold of me.

fr.L: Non que j’aie déjà reçu [cela] ou que j’aie déjà été rendu parfait, mais je poursuis [le but], si du moins je peux [le] saisir, parce que moi aussi j’ai été saisi par le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.
fr.B: Je ne veux pas dire que je possède déjà tout cela, ou que j’ai déjà été rendu parfait. Mais je continue à le poursuivre, en cherchant à m’en saisir, parce que le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} s’est saisi de moi.
fr.R: Je ne dis pas que j’ai déjà tout cela, ou que je suis déjà parfait. Mais je continue à courir pour essayer de le saisir, parce que le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} m’a saisi, moi.

es.L: No que ya [lo] haya recibido o que ya haya sido hecho perfecto, sino que [lo] persigo, por si logro alcanzar[lo], porque también yo fui alcanzado por {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}.
es.B: No quiero decir que ya tenga todo esto, ni que ya haya sido hecho perfecto. Pero sigo persiguiéndolo, tratando de alcanzarlo, porque {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} me ha alcanzado a mí.
es.R: No digo que ya tenga todo esto, ni que ya sea perfecto. Pero sigo corriendo tras ello, tratando de agarrarlo, porque {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} me agarró a mí.

sw.L: Si kwamba tayari nimepokea [hilo] au tayari nimekamilishwa, bali ninalifuatilia, ikiwa kweli nipate kulishika, kwa kuwa mimi pia nilishikwa na {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.B: Simaanishi kwamba tayari nimepata haya yote, au kwamba tayari nimefanywa mkamilifu. Lakini ninaendelea kuyafuatilia, nikijitahidi kuyashika, kwa sababu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} amenishika mimi.
sw.R: Sisemi kwamba tayari nimepata haya yote, au kwamba tayari mimi ni mkamilifu. Lakini ninaendelea kuyakimbilia, nikijaribu kuyashika, kwa sababu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} alinishika mimi.

ko.L: 내가 이미 받았다거나 이미 완전하게 되었다는 것이 아니라, 내가 그것을 붙잡으려고 좇아가고 있습니다. 나도 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께 붙잡혔기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 내가 이 모든 것을 이미 얻었다거나 이미 완전하게 되었다는 말이 아닙니다. 그러나 나는 그것을 붙잡으려고 계속 좇아가고 있습니다. {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 나를 붙잡아 주셨기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 내가 이 모든 것을 이미 다 가졌다거나 이미 완전해졌다는 말은 아닙니다. 그러나 나는 그것을 붙잡으려고 계속 달려가고 있습니다. {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 나를 붙잡아 주셨기 때문입니다.

vi.L: Không phải tôi đã nhận được [điều ấy] hoặc đã trở nên trọn vẹn rồi, nhưng tôi đang theo đuổi, mong sao nắm được [điều ấy], vì chính tôi cũng đã được {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} nắm lấy.
vi.B: Tôi không có ý nói rằng tôi đã có được tất cả những điều ấy, hay đã trở nên trọn vẹn rồi. Nhưng tôi cứ theo đuổi, cố gắng nắm lấy điều ấy, vì {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} đã nắm lấy tôi.
vi.R: Tôi không nói rằng tôi đã có được tất cả những điều ấy, hay đã hoàn hảo rồi. Nhưng tôi cứ chạy theo, cố gắng nắm lấy điều ấy, vì {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} đã nắm lấy tôi.

decisions.choice: what he has not yet received: the goal of verses 10-11
decisions.reason: The verb has no object. The context supplies it: full knowledge of Christ and the resurrection Paul has just spoken of. He guards against anyone thinking he has already arrived.

decisions.choice: brought to completion, made perfect
decisions.reason: τελειόω means to bring something to its goal or finish. Paul says he has not yet reached that end. In verse 15 he plays on the related word for "mature".

decisions.choice: pursue, chase: the same verb as "persecuting" in verse 6
decisions.reason: διώκω means to run after, whether to catch someone or to reach a goal. The man who once pursued the church now pursues Christ. Verses 13-14 develop it as a runner's race.

decisions.choice: because
decisions.reason: ἐφ’ ᾧ can mean "because" or "that for which". Paul uses the phrase to mean "because" in Romans 5:12, 2 Corinthians 5:4 and Philippians 4:10, and that fits here: Christ took hold of him first. Read the other way, Paul pursues the purpose for which Christ took hold of him. The two are close; the footnote gives the other.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: by Christ
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts add "Jesus". The meaning does not change, so there is no footnote.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: lay hold / laid hold (L); take hold / taken hold (B); catch hold / caught hold (R)
decisions.reason: Paul uses the same verb twice, once active and once passive. Every level repeats the English verb so the reader sees the play: he reaches for what Christ has already reached him for.

decisions.choice: alcanzar / fui alcanzado (L, B); agarrar / me agarró (R)
decisions.reason: Paul plays on one verb used actively and passively; Spanish keeps the same verb in both halves at each level, as the English does. "Perseguir" is the same verb as "perseguidor" in verse 6 (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: kufuatilia (pursue); kushika / kushikwa (lay hold / be laid hold of)
decisions.reason: "Kufuatilia" (to go after, pursue) in Literal and Balanced; Readable says "kukimbilia" (run after), with the race picture of verses 13-14. One verb, "kushika", is kept for both "lay hold" and "was laid hold of", so the play on words in the Greek comes through at every level.

decisions.choice: "좇아가다" (L, B); "달려가다" (R) for the verb that is "persecuting" in verse 6
decisions.reason: The Greek verb is the same as "persecuting" in verse 6 (the meaning decision), turned now toward Christ. Korean cannot use one word for both; "좇아가다" (pursue) keeps the picture of chasing, and verse 14 keeps it.

decisions.choice: "붙잡다", "붙잡히다" (L); "붙잡다", "붙잡아 주시다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: One verb for Paul's laying hold and Christ's laying hold of him; Korean keeps one verb, "붙잡다", for both, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "theo đuổi" (L, B); "chạy theo" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for "persecuting" in verse 6 (m3); Vietnamese cannot keep one word for both, but "theo đuổi" keeps the sense of running after a goal, and Readable keeps the race.

source.text: ἀδελφοί, ἐγὼ ἐμαυτὸν οὐ λογίζομαι κατειληφέναι· ἓν δέ, τὰ μὲν ὀπίσω ἐπιλανθανόμενος τοῖς δὲ ἔμπροσθεν ἐπεκτεινόμενος, κατὰ σκοπὸν διώκω εἰς τὸ βραβεῖον τῆς ἄνω κλήσεως τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: Brothers, I myself not consider to have laid hold; one thing but, the things on the one hand behind forgetting, to the things on the other hand ahead stretching out, \v 14 toward goal I pursue to the prize of the upward calling of the God in Christ Jesus.

en.L: {{gender:Brothers and sisters|Brothers}}, I do not consider myself to have laid hold [of it]; but one thing [I do]: forgetting the things behind and stretching out to the things ahead, \v 14 I pursue toward [the] goal, for the prize of the upward call of God in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus.
en.B: {{gender:Brothers and sisters|Brothers}}, I do not count myself as having taken hold of it. My single aim is this: I put out of mind what is behind me and stretch out for what is in front of me, \v 14 and I run straight for the goal to win the prize promised by God's upward call in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus.
en.R: {{gender:Brothers and sisters|Brothers}}, I do not think I have caught hold of it yet. But I do one thing. I forget what is behind me and reach out for what is ahead. \v 14 I run straight for the finish line to win the prize God holds out to me when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} calls me up to heaven through {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus.

fr.L: {{gender:Frères et sœurs|Frères}}, pour moi, je n’estime pas [l’]avoir saisi ; mais une seule [chose] : oubliant ce qui est derrière et m’étendant vers ce qui est devant, \v 14 je poursuis vers le but, vers le prix de l’appel d’en haut de Dieu {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus.
fr.B: {{gender:Frères et sœurs|Frères}}, je n’estime pas m’en être déjà saisi. Je n’ai qu’un seul but : je laisse de côté ce qui est derrière moi et je m’élance vers ce qui est devant moi, \v 14 et je cours droit au but pour remporter le prix que Dieu promet par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} appel d’en haut {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus.
fr.R: {{gender:Frères et sœurs|Frères}}, je ne pense pas l’avoir déjà saisi. Mais je fais une seule chose. J’oublie ce qui est derrière moi et je tends tous mes efforts vers ce qui est devant. \v 14 Je cours droit vers la ligne d’arrivée pour gagner le prix que Dieu me promet quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’appelle à monter au ciel par le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus.

es.L: Hermanos, yo no considero haber[lo] alcanzado; pero una cosa [hago]: olvidando lo que [queda] atrás y extendiéndome hacia lo que [está] delante, \v 14 prosigo hacia [la] meta, por el premio del llamamiento de Dios hacia arriba en {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} Jesús.
es.B: Hermanos, no me considero como quien ya lo ha alcanzado. Mi único propósito es este: dejo atrás lo que queda detrás de mí y me lanzo hacia lo que tengo delante, \v 14 y corro derecho hacia la meta para ganar el premio que promete el llamado de Dios a lo alto en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} Jesús.
es.R: Hermanos, no creo que ya lo haya agarrado. Pero hago una cosa: olvido lo que está detrás de mí y me estiro hacia lo que está delante. \v 14 Corro derecho hacia la línea de llegada para ganar el premio que Dios me ofrece cuando me llama a subir al cielo por medio {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}} Jesús.

sw.L: Ndugu, mimi sijihesabu kuwa nimekwisha kulishika; lakini jambo moja: nikiyasahau yaliyo nyuma na kujinyoosha kuyafikia yaliyo mbele, \v 14 ninafuatilia kuelekea lengo, kwa ajili ya tuzo ya mwito wa juu wa Mungu katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu.
sw.B: Ndugu, sijioni kuwa nimekwisha kulishika. Ninazingatia jambo moja tu: nayaweka kando mawazoni yaliyo nyuma yangu, na kujinyoosha kuyafikia yaliyo mbele yangu, \v 14 nami ninakimbia moja kwa moja kuelekea lengo ili nishinde tuzo iliyoahidiwa na mwito wa Mungu wa kwenda juu katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu.
sw.R: Ndugu, sidhani kwamba tayari nimelishika. Lakini ninafanya jambo moja. Ninasahau yaliyo nyuma yangu na kujinyoosha kufikia yaliyo mbele. \v 14 Ninakimbia moja kwa moja kuelekea mstari wa mwisho ili nishinde tuzo ambayo Mungu ananiahidi anaponiita nipande mbinguni kupitia {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu.

ko.L: {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 나는 나 자신이 [그것을] 붙잡았다고 여기지 않습니다. 오직 한 가지, 뒤에 있는 것은 잊고 앞에 있는 것을 향하여 몸을 내밀며, \v 14 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 안에서 하나님께서 위로 부르신 부르심의 상을 위하여 목표를 향해 좇아갑니다.
ko.B: {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 나는 내가 그것을 이미 붙잡았다고 여기지 않습니다. 내가 오직 힘쓰는 한 가지는 이것입니다. 나는 뒤에 있는 것은 잊어버리고 앞에 있는 것을 향해 몸을 내밀며, \v 14 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 안에서 하나님께서 위로 부르시는 부르심의 상을 얻으려고 목표를 향해 곧장 달려갑니다.
ko.R: {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 나는 아직 그것을 붙잡았다고 생각하지 않습니다. 그러나 나는 한 가지 일을 합니다. 뒤에 있는 것은 잊어버리고 앞에 있는 것을 향해 힘껏 손을 뻗습니다. \v 14 나는 결승선을 향해 곧장 달려갑니다. 하나님께서 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수를 통해 나를 하늘로 부르실 때 내게 주시려고 내어 놓으신 상을 받으려는 것입니다.

vi.L: Thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, tôi không nghĩ rằng chính mình đã nắm được [điều ấy]; nhưng [tôi làm] một điều: quên đi những điều ở phía sau, và vươn tới những điều ở phía trước, \v 14 tôi nhắm mục đích mà chạy, để giành giải thưởng của sự kêu gọi lên cao của Đức Chúa Trời trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} Giê-xu.
vi.B: Thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, tôi không cho rằng mình đã nắm được điều ấy. Mục tiêu duy nhất của tôi là thế này: tôi quên đi những gì ở phía sau, và vươn tới những gì ở phía trước, \v 14 và tôi chạy thẳng tới đích để giành giải thưởng mà sự kêu gọi lên cao của Đức Chúa Trời trong Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} đã hứa ban.
vi.R: Thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, tôi không nghĩ là tôi đã nắm được điều ấy. Nhưng tôi làm một điều. Tôi quên đi những gì ở phía sau và vươn tới những gì ở phía trước. \v 14 Tôi chạy thẳng tới vạch đích để giành giải thưởng mà Đức Chúa Trời dành cho tôi khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} gọi tôi lên trời qua Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}.

decisions.choice: fellow believers, women and men
decisions.reason: ἀδελφοί addresses the whole church; 4:2 names two women in it.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: not
decisions.reason: Some manuscripts read "not yet". After "already" in verse 12 the sense is the same, so there is no footnote.

decisions.choice: one thing: a single focus, with no verb
decisions.reason: Paul writes only "but one thing"; the verb is left out for force, and the rest of the sentence says what that one thing is.

decisions.choice: no longer letting the past count or hold him back
decisions.reason: Paul has just recalled his past in detail (verses 4-6), so he does not mean he cannot remember it. Like a runner who does not look back, he no longer relies on it or lets it hold him.

decisions.choice: a footrace: straining forward, running for the mark, the winner's prize
decisions.reason: ἐπεκτείνομαι pictures a runner stretching toward the line; σκοπός is the mark the eye is fixed on; βραβεῖον is the prize for winning a race, as in 1 Corinthians 9:24.

decisions.choice: the prize that God's call upward holds out
alternatives: the call itself is the prize
the call to come up and receive the prize
decisions.reason: God calls his people upward, to the life above where Christ is (compare Colossians 3:1-2), and the prize is what that call promises. The phrase can also be read with the call itself as the prize, or as the summons that brings the winner up to receive it. All three readings agree that God is the one who calls and the goal is above.

decisions.choice: {{gender:Brothers and sisters|Brothers}}
decisions.reason: Paul is addressing the whole church, which includes the women he names in 4:2, so the inclusive default spells that out. Traditional is one tap away.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: finish line; calls me up to heaven; through
decisions.reason: Readable names the race picture and says where "upward" leads. "Yet" follows from "already" in verse 12.

decisions.choice: meta, premio; línea de llegada (R)
decisions.reason: Paul uses the words of a footrace (meaning decision m4): "meta" is the finish of a race in Spanish, and "premio" the prize. Readable says "línea de llegada", as the English says "finish line". The English pronoun for God in Readable has no Spanish counterpart because Spanish leaves the subject of "llama" unsaid.

decisions.choice: "sự kêu gọi lên cao" (L, B); "gọi tôi lên trời" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the prize as what God's upward call holds out (m6). "Lên cao" keeps the direction of the Greek word; Readable says where, as the English Readable does.

source.text: ὅσοι οὖν τέλειοι, τοῦτο φρονῶμεν· καὶ εἴ τι ἑτέρως φρονεῖτε, καὶ τοῦτο ὁ θεὸς ὑμῖν ἀποκαλύψει·

records.literal_gloss: As many as therefore mature, this let us think; and if anything differently you think, also this the God to you will reveal.

en.L: As many as [are] perfect, therefore, let us think this; and if in anything you think differently, God will reveal this also to you.
en.B: Those of us, then, who are mature should have this mindset. And if your thinking differs at some point, God will reveal that to you as well.
en.R: All of us who are grown up as believers should think this way. If you think differently about something, God will make that clear to you too.

fr.L: Ainsi, nous tous qui [sommes] parfaits, ayons cette façon de penser ; et si sur quelque point vous pensez autrement, cela aussi, Dieu vous le révélera.
fr.B: Ceux d’entre nous qui sont mûrs doivent donc avoir cet état d’esprit. Et si sur un point votre pensée diffère, Dieu vous révélera cela aussi.
fr.R: Nous tous qui sommes devenus des croyants adultes, nous devons penser ainsi. Si vous pensez autrement sur un point, Dieu vous le fera comprendre à vous aussi.

es.L: Así que, cuantos [somos] perfectos, pensemos esto; y si en algo {{plural_you:piensan|pensáis}} de otra manera, también esto {{plural_you:se lo|os lo}} revelará Dios.
es.B: Así que todos los que somos maduros debemos pensar de este modo. Y si en algún punto {{plural_you:piensan|pensáis}} de otra manera, Dios también {{plural_you:se lo|os lo}} hará ver.
es.R: Todos los que hemos crecido como creyentes debemos pensar así. Si {{plural_you:ustedes piensan|vosotros pensáis}} distinto sobre algo, Dios también {{plural_you:se lo|os lo}} aclarará.
